title: SpaceX's 13th Starship flight test launches with Starlink's next-gen satellites - Engadget
summary: This is the first Starship flight to carry SpaceX's next-generation V3 Starlink satellites, which were designed to provide meaningful increases to its service's performance. While Starship will deploy 20 satellites this flight, Starlink customers won't be feeling those improvements yet.
